protocol_overview.type: Application-layer (OSI level 7) request/reply messaging protocol with a transport-agnostic Protocol Data Unit (PDU = Function Code + Data) and three published Application Data Unit (ADU) framings: Modbus RTU (binary + CRC-16 on serial), Modbus ASCII (ASCII-hex + LRC on serial), and Modbus TCP (PDU + 7-byte MBAP header on TCP port 502).
protocol_overview.role_model: Single client (master) initiates a transaction; one or more servers (slaves) reply to addressed requests. Code 0 in the address field of an RTU/ASCII ADU is the broadcast address — broadcast frames are not acknowledged.

duplex_per_transport.Modbus TCP: full-duplex on TCP socket (multiple outstanding transactions per Transaction ID)

adu_format_per_transport.Modbus RTU: Address (1 B) + PDU (Function Code + Data, ≤ 253 B) + CRC-16-Modbus (2 B, low byte first) — total ≤ 256 B
adu_format_per_transport.Modbus ASCII: ':' (0x3A, 1 char) + Address (2 ASCII-hex chars) + Function Code (2 ASCII-hex chars) + Data (2N ASCII-hex chars) + LRC (2 ASCII-hex chars) + CR LF (2 chars)
adu_format_per_transport.Modbus TCP: MBAP Header (Transaction ID 2 B + Protocol ID 2 B = 0x0000 + Length 2 B + Unit ID 1 B) + PDU (≤ 253 B) — total ≤ 260 B

protocol_overview.byte_order_on_wire: big-endian (the most significant byte of a multi-byte numerical quantity is sent first)
function_code_categories: Bit Access — read/write Coils + read Discrete Inputs (FC 01, 02, 05, 15)
16-bit Access — read/write Holding Registers + read Input Registers (FC 03, 04, 06, 16, 22, 23) + read FIFO (FC 24)
File Record Access — read/write reference-type-6 file records (FC 20, 21)
Diagnostics — Read Exception Status (FC 07), Diagnostics sub-function set (FC 08), Get Comm Event Counter (FC 11), Get Comm Event Log (FC 12), Report Server ID (FC 17)
Encapsulated Interface Transport — Function Code 43 with MEI Type field; MEI Type 13 = CANopen, MEI Type 14 = Read Device Identification

data_model_tables.name: Discrete Inputs
data_model_tables.source: Typically physical input lines / I/O system

protocol_overview.address_mapping_rule: PDU address X corresponds to user-facing data-model number X+1; explicitly: a MODBUS data numbered X is addressed in the MODBUS PDU as X-1.

functional_requirements.text: Every MODBUS request and response shall contain a Protocol Data Unit (PDU) whose first byte is the function code (1..255 decimal, excluding 0). The remainder of the PDU is function-code-dependent Data of length 0..252 bytes. The PDU shall not exceed 253 bytes.

For serial line transports the ADU = Address (1 byte) + PDU + error-check field. RTU appends a 2-byte CRC-16-Modbus (low byte first); ASCII appends a 2-ASCII-hex LRC plus CR LF; total RTU ADU ≤ 256 bytes.
For MODBUS TCP the ADU = MBAP Header (7 bytes: Transaction ID 2 B + Protocol ID 2 B equal to 0x0000 + Length 2 B + Unit ID 1 B) + PDU; total TCP ADU ≤ 260 bytes; MBAP.Length covers Unit ID + PDU.

Function code 0 shall be rejected as invalid. Function codes 128..255 (i.e. function_code | 0x80) shall be used only as exception responses. Codes 65..72 and 100..110 are User-Defined; the remainder of 1..127 is reserved for Public function codes.

The protocol shall expose up to four independent data tables — Discrete Inputs (1-bit RO), Coils (1-bit R/W), Input Registers (16-bit RO), Holding Registers (16-bit R/W). Each table addresses up to 65536 items numbered 0..65535 in the PDU (1..65536 to the user).

Function Code 0x01 Read Coils shall accept Starting Address (2 B, 0x0000..0xFFFF) + Quantity of Coils (2 B, 1..2000 / 0x07D0); response = Function Code + Byte Count (1 B = ceil(N/8)) + Coil Status (Byte Count bytes), with LSB of first byte = first coil addressed.
Function Code 0x02 Read Discrete Inputs shall accept Starting Address (2 B) + Quantity of Inputs (2 B, 1..2000 / 0x07D0); response identical-shape to FC 1.

Function Code 0x03 Read Holding Registers shall accept Starting Address (2 B) + Quantity of Registers (2 B, 1..125 / 0x007D); response = Function Code + Byte Count (1 B = 2N) + Register Value (2N B, high byte first).
Function Code 0x04 Read Input Registers shall accept Starting Address (2 B) + Quantity of Input Registers (2 B, 1..125 / 0x007D); response identical-shape to FC 3.
Function Code 0x05 Write Single Coil shall accept Output Address (2 B) + Output Value (2 B; only 0xFF00 = ON and 0x0000 = OFF are valid). Normal response echoes the request.
Function Code 0x06 Write Single Register shall accept Register Address (2 B) + Register Value (2 B). Normal response echoes the request.

Function Code 0x0F Write Multiple Coils shall accept Starting Address (2 B) + Quantity of Outputs (2 B, 1..1968 / 0x07B0) + Byte Count (1 B = ceil(N/8)) + Output Value bytes. Response = Function Code + Starting Address + Quantity of Outputs.

Function Code 0x10 Write Multiple Registers shall accept Starting Address (2 B) + Quantity of Registers (2 B, 1..123 / 0x007B) + Byte Count (1 B = 2N) + Registers Values (2N B, high byte first). Response = Function Code + Starting Address + Quantity of Registers.

Function Code 0x16 Mask Write Register shall accept Reference Address (2 B) + AND_Mask (2 B) + OR_Mask (2 B); the server shall compute Result = (Current Contents AND AND_Mask) OR (OR_Mask AND (NOT AND_Mask)) and write it back. Response echoes the request.

Function Code 0x17 Read/Write Multiple Registers shall accept Read Starting Address (2 B) + Quantity to Read (2 B, 1..125) + Write Starting Address (2 B) + Quantity to Write (2 B, 1..121) + Write Byte Count (1 B) + Write Registers Values (2N B). Response = Function Code + Byte Count + Read Registers Values.

Function Code 0x18 Read FIFO Queue shall accept FIFO Pointer Address (2 B); response = Function Code + Byte Count (2 B, ≤ 64) + FIFO Count (2 B, ≤ 31 / 0x001F) + FIFO Values (2 B per register, ≤ 31 registers).

Function Code 0x14 Read File Record and 0x15 Write File Record shall access Reference Type 6 file records identified by File Number (2 B, 1..0xFFFF) + Record Number (2 B, 0..0x270F) + Record Length (2 B, registers). A single PDU may carry multiple sub-requests; Byte Count limits each to ≤ 252 B PDU.
Function Code 0x07 Read Exception Status (serial only) shall return one 8-bit byte representing eight pre-defined device-specific exception-status bits.

Function Code 0x08 Diagnostics (serial only) shall accept Sub-function code (2 B) + Data (2 B); supported sub-functions are 0..18 and 20 (Annex A reserves further sub-codes). Sub-function 0 = Return Query Data, 1 = Restart Communications Option, 2 = Return Diagnostic Register, 3 = Change ASCII Input Delimiter, 4 = Force Listen Only Mode, 10 = Clear Counters and Diagnostic Register, 11..15 + 17..18 + 20 = various counters (bus message, comm error, exception error, server message, busy, char overrun, register).
Function Code 0x0B Get Comm Event Counter (serial only) shall return a 2-byte Status word + a 2-byte Event Count.
Function Code 0x0C Get Comm Event Log (serial only) shall return Byte Count + Status (2 B) + Event Count (2 B) + Message Count (2 B) + Events byte sequence (≤ 64 events).
Function Code 0x11 Report Server ID (serial only) shall return Byte Count + Server ID (device-specific) + Run Indicator Status (0x00 = OFF, 0xFF = ON) + additional device-specific data.

Function Code 0x2B Encapsulated Interface Transport shall be followed by a 1-byte MEI Type. MEI Type 0x0D (13) = CANopen General Reference; MEI Type 0x0E (14) = Read Device Identification (vendor name, product code, revision, vendor URL, product name, model name, user app name, plus optional regular / extended object IDs).

On any of (a) unsupported function code, (b) illegal data address, (c) illegal data value, (d) server failure during execution, (e) acknowledge, (f) server busy, (g) memory parity error, (h) gateway path unavailable, (i) gateway target failed to respond, the server shall return an Exception PDU = (Function Code OR 0x80, 1 B) + (Exception Code, 1 B). Exception codes are 0x01 ILLEGAL FUNCTION, 0x02 ILLEGAL DATA ADDRESS, 0x03 ILLEGAL DATA VALUE, 0x04 SERVER DEVICE FAILURE, 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE, 0x06 SERVER DEVICE BUSY, 0x08 MEMORY PARITY ERROR, 0x0A GATEWAY PATH UNAVAILABLE, 0x0B GATEWAY TARGET DEVICE FAILED TO RESPOND.
All multi-byte numerical quantities shall be transmitted big-endian: the most significant byte is sent first. Example: a 16-bit value 0x1234 is transmitted as the byte sequence 0x12, 0x34.
Within the PDU, a data item numbered X (1-indexed in the user model) shall be addressed as X-1 (0-indexed in the PDU). The maximum addressable index in any of the four primary tables is 65535 (PDU).

On serial-line transports, Address 0 in the ADU is the Broadcast address. Servers shall not reply to a broadcast frame. Only commands that can be broadcast safely (e.g. some Write Multiple Coils / Registers) may use it; Read codes are not broadcastable.

The client should manage a request timeout to avoid waiting indefinitely for a server that does not reply (server offline, transmission error detected by the server, etc.). The spec does not mandate a value; it must be chosen per network latency and server response time.

error_response_conditions: Function code not implemented → exception code 0x01 ILLEGAL FUNCTION.
Starting Address or (Starting Address + Quantity - 1) outside the server's data-table range → exception code 0x02 ILLEGAL DATA ADDRESS.
Quantity field outside the per-function limit (e.g. > 0x07D0 coils, > 0x007D registers, etc.) or an Output Value of FC 5 that is neither 0xFF00 nor 0x0000 → exception code 0x03 ILLEGAL DATA VALUE.
Unrecoverable internal error during execution → exception code 0x04 SERVER DEVICE FAILURE.
Long-running programming command accepted but not yet complete → exception code 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE (the client may issue Poll Program Complete later).
Server engaged in another long-duration command and cannot service the request now → exception code 0x06 SERVER DEVICE BUSY (client should retransmit later).
Function 0x14 / 0x15 reference-type-6 file area failed a consistency check → exception code 0x08 MEMORY PARITY ERROR.
Gateway misconfigured / overloaded between input port and output port → exception code 0x0A GATEWAY PATH UNAVAILABLE.
Gateway forwarded the request but no response from the target device → exception code 0x0B GATEWAY TARGET DEVICE FAILED TO RESPOND.
On serial line: communication error detected by the server (parity, framing, CRC, LRC mismatch) → NO response is sent; the client will time out.
compliance_requirements: MODBUS PDU shall not exceed 253 bytes regardless of transport.
Modbus RTU ADU shall not exceed 256 bytes.
Modbus TCP ADU shall not exceed 260 bytes; MBAP.Protocol_ID shall be 0x0000.
Function code field shall be coded in 1 byte; value 0 is invalid.
Exception response shall set the MSB of the function code (Function | 0x80).
Big-endian byte order shall be used for all multi-byte numerical quantities.
Quantity-of-coils / discrete-inputs in a single FC 1 / 2 request shall be 1..2000.
Quantity-of-registers in a single FC 3 / 4 request shall be 1..125.
Quantity in FC 0x0F shall be 1..1968; quantity in FC 0x10 shall be 1..123; FC 0x17 read 1..125 + write 1..121.
FC 0x05 output value shall be exactly 0xFF00 (ON) or 0x0000 (OFF).
FC 0x18 shall return at most 31 (0x1F) FIFO registers.
